features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Two different ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

choices.name: First +1
choices.description: Choose one ability score to increase by 1.

choices.name: Second +1
choices.description: Choose a different ability score to increase by 1.

features.name: Construct Resilience
features.description: Your body is constructed, which frees you from some of the limits of flesh-and-blood creatures. You have resistance to poison damage, you are immune to disease, and you have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

features.name: Construct Vitality
features.description: You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe, and you don't sleep the way most creatures do. Instead, you enter a dormant state where you resemble a statue and remain semiconscious for 6 hours a day. While in this dormant state, you have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

features.name: Living Construct
features.description: Your consciousness and soul reside within a soul gem to animate your mechanical body. You are a living creature with some of the benefits and drawbacks of a construct. You can regain hit points from spells like cure wounds, but you can also be affected by game effects that specifically target constructs, such as the shatter spell.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common, Machine Speech, and a language associated with your Race Chassis.
